gaps_sample.description: The CAS index lag (missing index entries for existing valid hashed files) is currently bubbled up as a severe CAS violation in zqk system check. Since this is a known non-destructive indexing race condition inherent to our architecture, the storage provider should either lazily auto-heal the index upon detection or zqk system check should silently apply the auto-fix for index lags without raising user-facing errors.
